descripcion_geo: Mountain in Moab east of the Jordan (present-day Jordan) overlooking the entire promised land. Place of death of Moses.
importancia_estrategica: Moses's last place: He went up there to see the promised land and died.

historias.titulo: Moses climb Nebo and see the promised land
historias.descripcion: From Mount Nebo, Moses views the entire promised land from Gilead to Negev, the Great Sea and the Jordan.

historias.titulo: The death of Moses in the Nebo
historias.descripcion: Moses dies on Mount Nebo at 120 years of age; God buries him and no one knows his tomb.

historias.titulo: The Ark of the Covenant hidden in the Nebo
historias.descripcion: The second book of Maccabees relates that Jeremiah hid the tabernacle and the ark in a cave on Mount Nebo.

personajes.descripcion: He died on Mount Nebo in sight of the promised land that he was not allowed to set foot on; the greatest prophet of the OT.
He waited in the camp while Moses climbed the Nebo to die.
Tradition from the book of Maccabees links it to the hiding place of the ark in Nebo.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Mount Nebo: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: To this day, no one knows where the tomb of Moses is (Deut 34:6): a mystery that preserves the greatest prophet from all postmortem idolatry.
judaismo.significado_teologico: To this day, no one knows where the tomb of Moses is (Deut 34:6): a mystery that preserves the greatest prophet from all postmortem idolatry.

cristianismo.descripcion: The Transfiguration of Jesus includes Moses; The contrast with Nebo is notable: there he died without entering, in Hermon he appears glorified.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The Transfiguration of Jesus includes Moses; The contrast with Nebo is notable: there he died without entering, in Hermon he appears glorified.

islam.descripcion: Islam considers Musa (Moses) the greatest prophet before Muhammad; His death in Nebo is narrated in Islamic traditions.
islam.significado_teologico: Islam considers Musa (Moses) the greatest prophet before Muhammad; His death in Nebo is narrated in Islamic traditions.
